statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
There is concern for underlying sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
CPT code 93229 (prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
Diagnosis codes G45.9, I47.1, and I49.5 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
SilverBridge Advantage requires pre-approval for non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services
